evidence: provider documentation and crit-labs' own source; calls, formats and GPUs are as the providers state them, not measured by crit unless a kernel says so

operations.verify: on the target, compute two partitions' partials and their merge with the kernels and with attention_partial and merge_partials: outputs within BF16 probability rounding, log-sum-exps within FP32 error

kernels.call: a prefill or decode wrapper's run(..., return_lse=True) for each partition, then flashinfer.merge_state(v_a, s_a, v_b, s_b) (or merge_states for several)
